name: lazyforensic
description: Google Antigravity + Gemini 3.8 Flash forensic assistant — 4 lanes (help/forensic/visual/legal). Not a forensic acquisition or court-admissibility suite. Organizes evidence, parses Kakao text exports, renders timelines, drafts reports, and guards integrity via SHA-256 audit hooks.

interface.shortDescription: Forensic evidence organizer for Antigravity (not a court suite)
interface.longDescription: Equips Antigravity with 4 lanes (help/forensic/visual/legal) for Gemini 3.8 Flash: Kakao text-export parsing, os.stat hash/timestamp checks, timeline visualization, report drafts, and SHA-256 audit hooks. Not a forensic acquisition or court-admissibility suite. EVTX/MFT/Memory triage are bring-your-own-binary wrappers (Hayabusa/Chainsaw/Dissect/MemProcFS) — no bundled acquisition, no court claim.
